Coverage_Description: International medical insurance (Platinum) for inpatient/daypatient hospitalisation, accommodation, cancer and mental health; annual overall maximum paid in full. Optional International Vision & Dental adds 1 eye test per period, eyewear up to US$310/€245/£200, and dental cover up to US$5,500/€4,300/£3,50
customer requirement: standalone individual policy; beneficiaries must be expatriates
price structure: 1-year renewable term; premiums age-based and adjusted each renewal
additional informations: vision/dental waiting periods: 3 months (preventative/routine), 12 months (major restorative), 18 months (orthodontic); 21-day free-look; prior authorisation needed for inpatient/daypatient
